componentDescription:
The chart toolbar component for the premium package.
It adds the Excel export entry to the Pro toolbar's export menu.

dataGridExportOptions.description: The options to apply on the Excel export of the Data Grid's data. The entry is only shown when onDataGridExcelExport is provided, which the Data Grid integration does.

excelExportOptions.description: The options to apply on the Excel export of the chart's own data.

exportMenuItems.description: Extra items rendered at the end of the export menu.

onDataGridExcelExport.description: Exports the data of the Data Grid the chart is bound to, rather than the chart's own data.

Promise<void>.name: Promise<void>
Promise<void>.description: A promise that resolves once the export is done.

onExcelExport.description: Overrides how the chart's data is exported. Defaults to apiRef.current.exportAsExcel, and is required for a chart that does not register useChartPremiumExport, such as the one in the Data Grid integration.

options.name: options
options.description: The options to apply on the Excel export.

Promise<void>.name: Promise<void>
Promise<void>.description: A promise that resolves once the export is done.

rangeButtons.description: Configuration for range buttons shown in the toolbar. Each button zooms the chart to a predefined time range from the end of the data.

rangeButtonsAxisId.description: The axis ID to apply range buttons to. Defaults to the first x-axis with zoom enabled and a time scale.
